introText: I'm <highlighted>Michał Pietrykowski</highlighted>, a full stack developer from <highlighted>Wrocław</highlighted>. I wrote my first programs, mostly text adventures, in <highlighted>QBASIC</highlighted> in secondary school. Today I work mainly in <highlighted>Python</highlighted> and <highlighted>TypeScript</highlighted>, and for the past year mostly on <highlighted>LLM-based</highlighted> products.
academicText: I have an engineering degree in <highlighted>IT Automation Systems</highlighted> from <highlighted>Wrocław University of Science and Technology</highlighted> (grade 5.0). I'm now doing a part-time master's in <highlighted>Computer Science</highlighted> at WSB Merito University and should finish in early 2027.
skillText: I care a lot about <highlighted>code review</highlighted> and <highlighted>automated tests</highlighted>. In my free time I build <highlighted>VELMOIS</highlighted>, the online store for our moissanite jewelry brand, which runs on my own server.
hobbyText: Outside of programming I read <highlighted>Asimov</highlighted>, drink a lot of <highlighted>coffee</highlighted> and keep coming back to <highlighted>Cyberpunk 2077</highlighted>.

educationItems.school: Wrocław University of Science and Technology
educationItems.note: Grade 5.0. Thesis: a web application for tracking gym progress (GymTracker).

experienceItems.title: Full Stack Developer (AI)
experienceItems.description: Main author of the AI assistant in STRUCTURA, a SaaS platform where companies define their own data schemas and an LLM fills them with data from documents, Gmail, OwnCloud and Google Calendar.
highlights: Built the assistant's chat in Next.js and LangChain, with streaming and threaded history, and extended it so it can do everything the UI can.
The agent never saves data on its own. Every change goes to the user as a proposal and runs only after approval.
Built a Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that fills in forms on web pages with data from the system, with Auth0 login and tests in Vitest.

experienceItems.title: Full Stack Developer
experienceItems.description: Developing the IRMATIC CMS and the apps running on IRMATIC medicine cabinets and smart lockers.
highlights: Leading the integration of IRMATIC devices with the AMMS hospital system, working directly with Asseco and hospital staff.
Front end in Vue.js, Quasar and TypeScript, back end in Flask, SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL.
Writing tests in Pytest and deploying with Docker on AWS, where the infrastructure is managed in Terraform.

experienceItems.title: Full Stack Developer
highlights: Built REST APIs and microservices in Django, Django REST Framework and FastAPI, with React on the front end.
Wrote Airflow DAGs for data processing and prepared documentation for moving from on-premise to AWS.
Maintained CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and test suites in Pytest.

experienceItems.title: Software Engineer Intern & QA Automation Intern
highlights: Maintained the Dolby Access desktop app in C# and .NET: fixed bugs, added features and wrote xUnit tests.
Earlier, as a QA intern, built Python test automation in Pytest, including a Raspberry Pi USB Gadget package and a Page Object Model, and helped with regression testing.

futureText1: At work I want to keep building AI agents that work on real company data, where every change has to be approved by the user.
futureText2: Outside of work I'm getting <highlighted>VELMOIS</highlighted> ready for launch, and I'd like to finally start a tech blog.
futureText3: I'm open to fully remote work on a B2B contract. If you have a project or a job offer, or just know a good <highlighted>ramen place in Wrocław</highlighted>, write to me through the <highlighted>contact form</highlighted>.
